context.title: Geology
context.text: EGLE describes sediment-hosted copper in the Nonesuch Formation, with fine-grained chalcocite. The linked USGS assays are selected core evidence; this workflow does not estimate reserves from them.

context.title: Engineering
context.text: The June 2026 update targets an updated feasibility study in Q1 2027. The proposed recovery remains subject to engineering and operating validation.

gates.title: Permit descriptions need reconciliation
gates.text: The developer calls Copperwood “fully permitted.” EGLE lists “Issued, not effective” and says construction has not commenced. EGLE supplies no publication date here; scope and freshness must be reconciled before drawing an operating-status conclusion.

gates.title: Grant approval has conditions
gates.text: The August 2026 announcement reports a US$50m award across the project and road commission. Reimbursement depends on a definitive agreement and evidence of US$150m additional financing commitments by March 31, 2028, plus completion milestones. This does not establish full project funding.

gates.title: First production date is unverified
gates.text: A current, funded construction-to-production schedule is not established by these reviewed sources. Historical study dates are not actual production observations.

gates.title: Refined delivery is unverified
gates.text: No verified smelter/refinery allocation, offtake, transport commitment or delivered-product schedule is included in this evidence bundle.

scope: One project, deterministic scenario only. No current supply forecast, global economic simulation or learned acquisition policy.
redistribution: Original short factual summaries and attribution links. Full source pages are retained locally and are not redistributed.
